scope: Exact IDLE-selected KF resource staging and parsed-controller sampling

expectations.given: Root, one and two directories contain same.kf with translations 1, 9 and 17
expectations.expected: Selecting ONE\SAME.KF normalizes to meshes/one/same.kf, retains its 16-byte parsed file hash and samples translation 9; ordinary same winner remains unchanged
Preparation publishes no source, supported group, callback or playback; first commit succeeds and second fails; reuse adds no source
Missing nested KF cannot fall back to root same.kf; duplicate sequences and non-KF reject without publication; oversized native path throws
Competing source publication, clear, root replacement and owner destruction reject pending candidates
Missing first sequence root stays absent after later valid source; first valid root record 4 remains after later missing source
A single trackless native sequence retains file identity and advances its playback clock by .5
Later ordinary alias winner cannot impersonate cached exact resource; ordinary source publication invalidates staged source
Actual IDLE World selection Outside\same.kf prepares meshes/outside/same.kf and samples translation 9 while full combat/RNG capture remains unchanged
Existing ESM4NativeAnimationMetadata.OriginalSequenceCoordinatesAndCopies checks loader hash and shallow holder-copy preservation
After replacing same-path KF bytes and clearing resource caches, new preparation has a distinct parsed hash/group; new and old groups independently sample translations 27 and 9

boundaries: Headless real World/resource/parser/renderer tests, not normal-input gameplay acceptance
Resource commit registers a source only; physical slot5 clock, live RNG publication and save/restart integration remain open
No fresh executable oracle; existing original selector and first-sequence root evidence is reused
Resources with multiple native sequences or no native sequence metadata are unsupported by this API
